claims.head: Panarin gets company tonight
claims.call: The Islanders’ L3 (Palát, Pageau and Duclair) spends at least 26% of its 5-on-5 time against the Kings’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Islanders keep sending Pageau’s line (Palát, Pageau and Duclair) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Peter DeBoer has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Kings’ first line is Panarin, Laferriere and Kempe.

claims.gist: At home, Peter DeBoer likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Kings’ first line.

NYI.head: A genuine toss-up
NYI.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though the Islanders will be without Barzal, the Islanders have home-ice advantage, and Los Angeles will be without Fiala. The Islanders can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

LAK.head: Nothing to separate these two
LAK.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though the Islanders will be without Barzal, the Islanders have home-ice advantage, and Los Angeles will be without Fiala. For the Kings, the difference could be a penalty kill that holds up.
